statement: Fix D0 > 0, and put η = ℓ−D0 and ρ = η3. Typically for nonsingular binary matrices B of size m ∈ IN , the following assertion holds simultaneously for every BZm ⊆ K ⊆ Zm. Let S1, . . . , Sh ⊂ {0, 1}m be nonempty subsets, each ρ-robust on its affine span, where h ≤ 3/η. Suppose Si − Si ⊂ K, and put Wi = span(Si − Si). Suppose also that W = P i Wi is a direct sum. Write dim Wi = tiN, t = X i ti, |Si| = 2αiN . If D ⊂ [m] has |D| = xN, x ≤ t, and MK(D) ≤ 2ηN , then xt − x2 2 ≤ X i ti(ti − αi) + ηt + η3 . (8.5)
